name: Couples counselling
summary: How expats find couples counselling in Singapore — registered psychologists vs counsellors, relocation stress themes, and privacy expectations for dual-career households.
body:
Couples counselling helps partners navigate relocation stress, parenting load, and dual-career conflict. Providers may be clinical psychologists, counsellors, or therapists — credentials and modality matter more than clinic polish.

## Decision points
- Psychologist vs counsellor pathway
- In-person vs secure telehealth for travel weeks
- Individual vs conjoint session mix
- Language / cultural matching needs
- Employer EAP vs private cash rates

Clarify confidentiality limits for EAP-referred work.

## How to choose
Prefer practitioners who explain their approach (e.g. EFT, Gottman-informed) and cancellation policies upfront. Ask about crisis pathways. Avoid anyone promising court outcomes in custody disputes.

## Practical tip
Agree on one shared goal sentence before session one. Unscoped “fix us” hours burn cash fast.
